trainable: all original model parameters, 338 tensors; no LoRA, no element mask

main.AdamW_moments: BF16, same torchAdamW policy as verified previous dense recipe

auxiliary.order: SHA256(aux42:+ID), cycle in order, identical B/C/D
auxiliary.B: mean of 16 original translation CE examples (two directions for each of 8 pairs)
auxiliary.C: mean 1-cos(current SW mean-pool, cached Base EN mean-pool)
auxiliary.D: SW-to-fixed-EN-bank InfoNCE, all 2000 teacher targets, temperature .07
auxiliary.teacher: frozen Base offline cache, no gradient; costs included separately
auxiliary.data_matching_limits: B processes both directions with prompts/labels; C/D SW content only plus amortized offline EN. Equal pair accesses, unequal tokens/F-B measured separately. Fixed .1 coefficients have different loss scales; one configuration only, no tuning after downstream scores.
auxiliary.batching_note: Before any downstream score: equal mean CE/InfoNCE per-example weights and8pairs/event unchanged; fixed2000-target bank means negatives unchanged; only grouped auxiliary forwards/backwards (B16examples as4x4, C/D8as2x4). BF16 accumulation order differs from archived serial technical prototype. Main effective batch unchanged.

layer_selection: Base representation dev only; highest mean-pool average bidirectional cosine P@1 among hidden_states1..28, ties nearest14 then lower

screening.primary: independent SW reading+translation and EN reading+instruction+math dev, paired outputs
screening.upgrade: alignment must beat same-pool CE on real SW tasks without >2 percentage point extra EN accuracy loss vs A; exploratory single-seed evidence, confirm with seeds and shuffled pairing before long run
screening.stop: no downstream gain beyond CE or throughput/memory/budget gate failure; no automatic scale-up

fixed_task_gate.primary_benefit: EN-to-SW chrF++ versus align-B paired95CI lower>0 for C and D separately
fixed_task_gate.SW_noninferiority: versus B: SWreading tokenF1 lowerCI >=-2points; SW-to-EN chrF++ lowerCI>=-1
fixed_task_gate.EN_retention: versus A: EN reading/math/instruction primary paired95CI lower>=-2points each
fixed_task_gate.interpretation: Exploratory two-variant screen, report both and all tasks, no confirmatory multiple-testing claim; passing only permits later discussion, does not automatically start long training

exception_scope: new sw-align queues only; existing and other account jobs count in total

tasks: published FLORES original dev128 documents bidirectional256
development.limits: Not formal Belebele/IFEval/GSM8K test; development proxies with task-specific exact scoring. Same fixed prompts/caps/scorer as sparse comparison. No downstream score used to select alignment layer.
development.bootstrap: 10000 paired source-cluster resamples, seed42; report all tasks and controls, no mixed task mean

quality.local_model: existing Qwen3-8B BF16; separate from training Qwen2.5-1.5B
quality.acceptance: YES probability among fixed YES/NO labels >= .9 in both input orders; known assistant-reviewed mismatches excluded
quality.pilot_gate: reject >=8 of10 clearly mismatched and accept >=25 of36 faithful assistant-reviewed sentinels; observed9/10 and31/36, passed
quality.limitation: Model-assisted semantic filtering is not native-human verification. Pilot missed one named-entity mismatch; blacklist observed mistakes, retain per-pair judgments and disclose residual errors. No threshold tuning on downstream.
quality.postreview_copy_exclusion: casefold/whitespace SequenceMatcher ratio>=.65; conservative, may exclude valid named-entity-heavy pairs
quality.main_Aya_additional_role_audit: 104764 prompt/answer fields of all selected Aya rows, numeric-masked character3-5gram TFIDF .8; 0 candidate-held matches
quality.manual_postreview: 60 deterministic hash-ranked accepted examples, known mismatches/copy cases excluded; 50 retained examples plus10 replacements reviewed. Some loose or ungrammatical translation remains; not native-human gold.

recovery: v1 nondeterministic CUDA failed actual resume-versus-continuous weight equality; v2 independently checks all model weights and moments, unchanged data/loss/learning schedule/budget
